{{Quote|Situation report, Commander.''"<br />"''The Celestial's crew is ordinary, Grand Moff. Ordinary men panic when their ship loses power and mobility. Survival becomes paramount.''"<br />"''Scared men are easy to command, given the promise of safety.''"<br />"''Some will stay loyal to Gryphon.''"<br />(smiling) "''I am sure we will think of something, Commander.|Grand Moff Ravik and Bane Nothos|<ref name="Otherspace">''[[Otherspace (adventure)|Otherspace]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Celestial''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]]. While en route to the Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]], carrying [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] such as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]],<ref name="Otherspace II: Invasion">''[[Otherspace II: Invasion]]''</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Mutiny on the Celestial|captured]] by its inmates [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]] and [[Bane Nothos]]. Its [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Alain Gryphon]], desperately sent the ship to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] before Imperial [[Relentless (Dorja)|reinforcements]] could arrive. However, a damaged [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] sent the ''Celestial'' to the mysterious [[Otherspace]] dimension.<ref name="Otherspace" />

The ''Celestial'' had two levels. On the upper level were an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], rec room, galley, tech shop, [[Medical bay/Legends|medical bay]], crew quarters, [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], communications station, captain's office, and captain's quarters. The lower level boasted a storage room, the ship's [[Prison/Legends|detainment cells]], a loading area and lower docking platform, a guard station, guards' quarters, [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor suite station]], and an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room that was tall enough to span both levels.<ref name="Otherspace" />

Upon its arrival in Otherspace, the ship  was boarded by [[Charon]] warriors via the lower docking platform, but the crew and prisoners had already taken four of the ''Celestial''{{'s}} five [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] to the nearby Charon ship ''[[Desolate]]''. When another Rebel [[GX1 short hauler|ship]], the ''[[Long Shot]]'', arrived on the scene, its crew explored the dying ''Celestial'' before entering the ''Desolate'' and doing [[Skirmish on the Desolate|battle]] with the Charon.<ref name="Otherspace" />
